title: mcp
description: Provides read access to your GKE and Kubernetes resources.
summary: Provides read access to your GKE and Kubernetes resources.
offersHint: Provides read access to your GKE and Kubernetes resources. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://container.googleapis.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_k8s_api_resources
toolsPreview.description: Retrieves the available API groups and resources from a Kubernetes cluster. This is similar to running `kubectl api-resources`.

toolsPreview.name: check_k8s_auth
toolsPreview.description: Checks whether an action is allowed on a Kubernetes resource. This is similar to running `kubectl auth can-i`.

toolsPreview.name: describe_k8s_resource
toolsPreview.description: Shows the details of a specific Kubernetes resource. This is similar to running `kubectl describe`.

toolsPreview.name: list_k8s_events
toolsPreview.description: Retrieves events from a Kubernetes cluster. This is similar to running `kubectl events`.

toolsPreview.name: get_k8s_resource
toolsPreview.description: Gets one or more Kubernetes resources from a cluster. Resources can be filtered by type, name, namespace, and label selectors. Returns the resources in YAML format. This is similar to running `kubectl get`.

toolsPreview.name: get_k8s_cluster_info
toolsPreview.description: Gets cluster endpoint information. This is similar to running `kubectl cluster-info`.

toolsPreview.name: get_k8s_version
toolsPreview.description: Retrieves Kubernetes client and server versions for a given cluster. This is similar to running `kubectl version`.

toolsPreview.name: get_k8s_rollout_status
toolsPreview.description: Checks the current rollout status of a Kubernetes resource. This is similar to running `kubectl rollout status`.

toolsPreview.name: list_clusters
toolsPreview.description: Lists GKE clusters in a given project and location. Location can be a region, zone, or '-' for all locations.

toolsPreview.name: create_cluster
toolsPreview.description: Creates a new GKE cluster in a given project and location. It's recommended to read the [GKE documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/concepts/configuration-overview) to understand cluster configuration options. Cluster creation will default to Autopilot mode, as recommended by GKE best practices. If the user explicitly wants to create a Standard cluster, you need to set autopilot.enabled=false in the cluster configuration. This is similar to running `gcloud container clusters create-auto` or `gcloud container clusters create`.

toolsPreview.name: update_cluster
toolsPreview.description: Updates a specific GKE cluster.

toolsPreview.name: get_cluster
toolsPreview.description: Gets the details of a specific GKE cluster.

toolsPreview.name: list_operations
toolsPreview.description: Lists GKE operations in a given project and location. Location can be a region, zone, or '-' for all locations.

toolsPreview.name: get_operation
toolsPreview.description: Gets the details of a specific GKE operation.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_operation
toolsPreview.description: Cancels a specific GKE operation.

toolsPreview.name: create_node_pool
toolsPreview.description: Creates a node pool for a specific GKE cluster.

toolsPreview.name: list_node_pools
toolsPreview.description: Lists the node pools for a specific GKE cluster.

toolsPreview.name: get_node_pool
toolsPreview.description: Gets the details of a specific node pool within a GKE cluster.

toolsPreview.name: update_node_pool
toolsPreview.description: Updates a specific node pool within a GKE cluster.

toolsPreview.name: get_k8s_logs
toolsPreview.description: Gets logs from a Kubernetes container in a pod. This is similar to running `kubectl logs`.

toolsPreview.name: apply_k8s_manifest
toolsPreview.description: Applies a Kubernetes manifest to a cluster using server-side apply. This is similar to running `kubectl apply --server-side`.

toolsPreview.name: delete_k8s_resource
toolsPreview.description: Deletes a Kubernetes resource from a cluster. This is similar to running `kubectl delete`.

toolsPreview.name: patch_k8s_resource
toolsPreview.description: Patches a Kubernetes resource. This is similar to running `kubectl patch`.
